classification.rationale: Completed woven 100% cotton baseball-style cap falls in heading 6505. The subheading for cotton, not knitted, headwear of cotton is 6505.00.20 with suffix .60 other. F80646 describes a nearly identical 100% cotton woven six-panel baseball cap, though its text does not quote a code, so the code comes from the current tariff tree.
